name: Neutral ink
summary: A plain black-and-white base with one swappable accent. Start here and replace the accent with your brand color.
guidance: Body text needs 4.5:1 against its background; large text (24px, or 19px bold) and UI borders need 3:1.
Use border-strong for input, checkbox and button outlines (they need 3:1). Use border only for decorative dividers; it intentionally fails 3:1.
Replace only the accent and danger roles with brand colors, then re-check the pairs listed here.
Use accent-text on accent fills; never place text-secondary on accent.
